fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the front-of-box product image on HABA's page https://www.habausa.com/collections/games/products/rhino-hero. The page's title and article number correspond to this HABA rule edition; reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who did a good deed most recently starts building.
officialTieBreak: If the players cannot agree, the youngest player starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This is the base game's instruction; Rhino Hero: Super Battle uses a different criterion.
